title: Prioritize parameterized evidence and real-platform validation
instruction: For the next OFS-001 memory-hierarchy Run, update the prior public-Web survey and prioritize evidence that can parameterize architecture exploration: bandwidth, average and tail latency, capacity, power, cost, coherence, data movement, interference, RAS, packaging, and placement policy. Compare HBM, CXL-attached and pooled memory, tiered memory, and emerging memory without treating them as interchangeable. Seek real-platform measurements, sensitivity studies, adoption constraints, and evidence that contradicts optimistic vendor claims. Track relevant Japanese-origin technologies within the global survey. Keep all outputs provisional unless the configured independent Consensus Gate passes. This Directive does not approve publication or a high-impact HPCI recommendation.
